files_changed.summary: Added /auth/v1/token (POST, grant_type=password) as a reference-only path scoped to a per-path `servers` override (local Supabase URL), clearly labeled as not served by this gateway. No other paths/schemas touched.

decisions: Used OpenAPI's per-path `servers` array (not the top-level servers list) so Swagger UI visually separates this Supabase-side path from the gateway's own /healthz and /v1/me, instead of implying the gateway serves it.
security: [] on this path, matching /healthz — it authenticates the caller against Supabase directly via apikey/anon key, not via this gateway's bearerAuth scheme.
commands_run: python3 script parsing openapi.yaml with PyYAML to confirm structure
curl against the already-running gateway instance to confirm it serves the updated spec live
